audit_logging_requirements: Export formats: CEF, JSON over HTTPS, syslog to Event Hub
SIEM targets: Azure Sentinel (primary), Splunk (secondary), Datadog (optional)

Required fields: timestamp, request_id, tenant_id, model_id, model_version, prompt_hash, response_length_tokens, latency_ms, outcome, policy_flags, kms_key_id, encryption_status, s3_object_path (if blob stored), requester_ip (masked), tls_subject
Access logs: api_key_id, route, http_verb, status_code, source_ip_cidr, peering_vnet_id, container_node_id
Retention options: 90d / 1y / 7y (default legal preference 7y for flagged events)
PII handling: redact PHI/PII from stored payloads; store only hashed identifiers; provide sampled plaintext only under consent and audit trail
Log integrity: signed log batches, SHA-256 chain, optional write-once S3 path with immutability policy for long-term retention
KMS integration: per-tenant KMS key IDs in audit metadata; logs must not expose plaintext keys; envelope encryption metadata only
Alerting hooks: SSE to Event Hub for high-severity events (policy violation, model drift alerts)
Rate/volume: support for high-throughput (1000s reqs/s) with batching to avoid SIEM throttles
log_schema_sample: common_fields: {timestamp, request_id, tenant_id, user_hash, model_id, model_version}
